item.title: Meghalaya Coal Mine Explosion Kills 25, Triggers Probe and Fresh Debate on Safety
item.description: A deadly explosion at an illegal coal mine in Meghalaya’s East Jaintia Hills has killed 25 workers, prompting arrests, rescue operations, and renewed scrutiny of unsafe mining practices.

item.title: Explained: How India Gains Edge Over China, Pakistan, Bangladesh in New US Trade Deal
item.description: India-US trade deal explained: here's how the great deal between the two economies is a greater push in favor of India.

item.title: India-US Trade Breakthrough: Tariffs Slashed to 18%, $500 Billion Deal Reshapes Ties
item.description: India and the United States have announced an interim trade framework that lowers tariffs, expands market access, and aims to boost bilateral trade to $500 billion over five years.

item.title: People of Purpose: Who Is Dr Imran Patel, the ‘SRK of Medicine’ Transforming Pediatric Care with Empathy
item.description: Social media sensation Dr. Imran Patel turns kids' tears into smiles with empathetic dances and viral myth-busting.

item.title: India–U.S. Trade Deal Explained: How Scrapping 25% U.S. Tariff Impacts Indian Exports
item.description: The U.S. officially removed additional 25 per cent tariffs on Indian goods starting today, February 7.

item.description: Ritu Tawde of the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is poised to take charge as the Mayor of Mumbai, a landmark move that will see the civic body’s highest elected office held by a party other than the Shiv Sena in nearly 25 years. item.title: Hyderabad Ayurvedic Doctor Loses Over ₹36.16 Lakh to Loan App and Investment Fraud; Police Launch Investigation
item.description: A Hyderabad-based doctor was allegedly coerced into paying fake fees and loans after being lured by online investment promises.

item.title: ‘Want to Get Laid’: Texts Reveal Indian Restaurateur’s Plan to Spike Woman’s Drink
item.description: Michelin-starred restaurateur Vikas Nath was convicted Friday for spiking a woman’s drink at a Mayfair club.

item.title: Three-Storey Building Collapses In Rajasthan’s Kota: 5 Rescued, Several Feared Trapped
item.description: A three-storey building housing a restaurant collapsed in Kota following days of construction-induced vibrations, leaving five hospitalised and several feared trapped beneath the debris.

item.title: One Cop Dead and Thirteen Injured as Surajkund Fair Ride Collapses in Haryana
item.description: A ride malfunction at Surajkund Mela killed an inspector during evacuation and injured 13 fairgoers, raising safety concerns.
